name: Callum Doyle
summary: Detail-oriented Data Engineer with 4 years of experience designing and optimizing high-throughput data architectures. Specialized in building scalable real-time streaming pipelines and cloud-native batch processing workflows that reduce latency and cloud infrastructure overhead.

experience.title: Data Engineer
experience.description: Designed and maintained real-time event streaming pipelines using Kafka and Apache Spark to process customer order metrics, reducing end-to-end processing latency from 15 seconds to under 2 seconds. Orchestrated complex batch workflows via Airflow on GCP, optimizing storage schemas and SQL query execution to decrease annual cloud infrastructure spend by $80,000. Rebuilt core data warehouse schemas using dbt, improving daily data model build reliability to 99.9% SLA.

experience.title: Junior Data Engineer
experience.description: Built and scaled ingestion pipelines using Python and SQL to integrate financial transaction metadata into a secure GCP analytics environment. Implemented monitoring and automated alerting architectures for Airflow DAGs, which reduced pipeline incident response times by 35%. Supported the migration of legacy batch execution jobs to Apache Spark, increasing historical transaction audit throughput by 3x.
